faq.a1: Menyesha ikintu cyatakaye cyangwa cyabonetse, sisitemu yacu yo guhuza ishaka ibihura, genzura ubunyangamugayo binyuze mu bibazo, kandi uzuze itangwa ukoresheje kode ya OTP yizewe.
faq.a2: Yego! Byaboneka+ ni ubuntu rwose ku baturage bose b'u Rwanda.
faq.q3: Ngaragaza nte ko ikintu ari icyanjye?
faq.a3: Iyo umenyesheje ikintu cyatakaye, ushyiraho ibibazo byo kugenzura nyir'ikintu wenyine yamenya gusubiza. Abasaba bagomba kubisubiza neza.
faq.a4: Koperative z'ubwikorezi ni amashyirahamwe ayobora ubwikorezi rusange mu Rwanda. Ni zo zifasha kubika ibintu byabonetse nk'abahuza bizezwa.
faq.a5: Amanota y'icyizere yawe yiyongera iyo usubije ibintu neza kandi ukaba inyangamugayo, kandi agabanuka mu gihe cy'ibibazo cyangwa ibikorwa by'uburiganya.

about.title: Ibyerekeye Byaboneka+
about.subtitle: Urubuga rw'u Rwanda rwo gushakisha ibintu byatakaye rushingiye ku cyizere
about.missionText: Kubaka ikoranabuhanga ry'ikoranabuhanga ryizewe kandi rikoreshwa n'abantu bose, rishimangira icyizere rusange n'ubushobozi mu buryo rusange bwa buri munsi mu Rwanda.

privacy.title: Amabwiriza y'ibanga
privacy.intro: Ibanga ryawe ni ingenzi kuri twe. Aya mabwiriza asobanura uko Byaboneka+ ikusanya, ikoresha, kandi irinda amakuru yawe bwite.
useItems: Gushoboza itumanaho ryizewe hagati y'abanyacyo n'ababibonye
Gukora no kugenzura kode za OTP z'itangwa
Kubara amanota y'icyizere ashingiye ku bikorwa
privacy.protectText: Dukoresha ingamba z'umutekano z'urwego rusange harimo amabanga, kwemeza umutekano, n'igenzura ry'ubushobozi.

terms.title: Amabwiriza y'imikorere
terms.intro: Mu gukoresha Byaboneka+, wemeye aya mabwiriza y'imikorere.
